Ex-Pack Corrugated Cartons PLC (PACK), packaging/corrugated cartons manufacturer, FYE 31 March. GROUP basis, Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026) vs Q1 FY2025/26 comparative (quarter ended 30 June 2025), both explicitly presented side-by-side on the face Consolidated Income Statement (p.2), Statement of Financial Position (p.1) and Statement of Cash Flows (p.4) of the filing -- a genuine same-quarter YoY compare (this filing, unlike some others in this batch, presents ONLY a single quarterly column, no separate YTD column, since Q1 is also the first quarter of the financial year). This is the first financial_statements entry for PACK; the document that existed in the `documents` table at the start of this task (quarter ended 31 December 2025) was stale and has been superseded by this freshly-sourced 30 June 2026 filing (see script header). Group has one consolidated subsidiary, Neptune Papers (Pvt) Limited (per Note 1); four further Neptune entities are listed as subsidiaries in Corporate Information (Servicers, Eco Friends, Recyclers, Nova) but only Neptune Papers is stated as consolidated -- the others are presumably dormant/non-material shells, not flagged further as this is outside the scope of the interim figures. Identity checks, all tie exactly: Group operating profit change YoY (102,686-141,951=-39,265) = Gross profit change (+26,552) + Other income change (-3,646) - Selling & distribution cost increase (-42,839) - Administrative expense increase (-19,332); Group PBT change (-8,074-51,348=-59,422) = operating profit change (-39,265) - finance cost increase (-20,157); Group PAT change (-8,074-34,921=-42,995) = PBT change (-59,422) + tax expense change (+16,427, tax fell to nil from a 16,427 expense). Group total_liabilities = Non-Current Liabilities (1,654,184) + Current Liabilities (5,095,140) = 6,749,324; Total Assets 10,767,126 = Total Liabilities 6,749,324 + Total Equity 4,017,802, ties exactly. minority_interest field = profit/(loss) ATTRIBUTABLE TO NCI for the period (2,203, a small profit allocation to Neptune Papers' non-controlling shareholders), NOT the balance-sheet NCI equity balance (468 at period-end) -- consistent with this project's convention (see CARE entry this batch). profit_after_tax = TOTAL profit/(loss) for the period (-8,074, incl. NCI), not the -10,277 attributable to equity holders of the parent; check: -8,074 - 2,203 = -10,277, ties exactly to the disclosed parent-attributable figure. eps_basic = eps_diluted = -0.03 (Group, attributable to equity holders of the parent: -10,277k / 333,333.333k weighted avg shares = -0.0308, rounds to -0.03, ties per Note 6 methodology and Note 4's 333,333,333 shares in issue). short_term_borrowings = 'Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings' CURRENT line only (4,351,538); long_term_borrowings = non-current line only (1,060,907); lease liabilities are embedded within Right-of-use assets/no separate lease-liability line is broken out on the face SOFP in this filing (unlike CARE), so no lease-vs-debt exclusion judgement call was needed here. trade_receivables = 'Trade and other receivables' (2,253,366) -- a combined receivables line, no further split disclosed. No segmental note is presented anywhere in this filing (PACK is a single-line corrugated-carton packaging manufacturer, so a segment note would not be expected) -- growth attribution below is limited to the P&L line items actually shown. cash_from_operations/capex/cash_from_investing/cash_from_financing are genuinely QUARTERLY (3-month) figures, not YTD-cumulative -- confirmed by the cash flow statement's own header 'For the Quarter ended 30th June' with only 2026/2025 columns, no 6- or 9-month column (unlike EML this batch).

interim_updates.note_text: Ex-Pack Corrugated Cartons PLC (PACK) swung from a Group Profit After Tax of Rs.34.9mn in Q1 FY2025/26 (quarter ended 30 June 2025) to a Group Loss After Tax of Rs.8.1mn in Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), a Rs.43.0mn decline, even though Group revenue grew 13.5% YoY to Rs.2,531.3mn (2025: Rs.2,230.7mn). The swing was driven by cost growth outpacing revenue growth at every subsequent line: cost of sales grew 15.1% (Rs.2,093.6mn vs Rs.1,819.6mn), compressing gross margin to 17.3% from 18.4% and limiting gross profit growth to just 6.5% (Rs.437.7mn vs Rs.411.2mn, +Rs.26.6mn). Selling and distribution costs then jumped 40.4% YoY to Rs.148.7mn (2025: Rs.105.9mn, +Rs.42.8mn) -- on its own larger than the entire Rs.26.6mn gross profit increase -- while administrative expenses rose a further 10.2% to Rs.208.8mn (2025: Rs.189.5mn, +Rs.19.3mn); combined, these two cost lines rose Rs.62.2mn, more than double the Rs.26.6mn gross profit gain, and Other income and gains also fell 13.9% (Rs.22.5mn vs Rs.26.1mn). Operating profit accordingly fell 27.7% to Rs.102.7mn (2025: Rs.142.0mn). Finance cost rose a further 22.2% YoY to Rs.110.8mn (2025: Rs.90.6mn, +Rs.20.2mn), which alone was enough to push the Group from a Rs.51.3mn pre-tax profit into a Rs.8.1mn pre-tax loss. No income tax was charged this quarter (2025: Rs.16.4mn expense), partially cushioning the swing -- Group PAT (incl. NCI) fell to a Rs.8.1mn loss (2025: Rs.34.9mn profit, a 123.1% decline), with a Rs.2.2mn profit allocated to non-controlling interests in Neptune Papers (Pvt) Limited (2025: a Rs.0.006mn NCI loss) meaning the loss attributable to parent equity holders was larger, at Rs.10.3mn (2025: a Rs.34.9mn profit). Company (standalone) PAT was a narrow Rs.2.2mn profit (2025: Rs.31.5mn, -92.9%), similarly pressured by Selling & distribution costs +43.5% (Rs.134.5mn vs Rs.93.7mn) and finance cost +17.8% (Rs.73.3mn vs Rs.62.3mn), plus a 95.4% collapse in Other income and gains (Rs.1.0mn vs Rs.22.4mn, a Rs.21.4mn decline not itemised in the filing). Operating cash flow was negative both years but deteriorated further to a Rs.647.0mn outflow (2025: Rs.524.1mn outflow) on a Rs.313.2mn inventory build and a Rs.526.6mn reduction in trade and other payables, funded by Rs.501.8mn of net new interest-bearing borrowing and Rs.115.0mn of a new lease.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is the first financial_statements entry for PACK, so there is no prior quarter (e.g. Q4 FY2025/26 ended 31 March 2026) in the database to compare against; yoy_json compares only to the filing's own prior-year comparative quarter (Q1 FY2025/26). Genuine disclosure gaps: (1) no breakdown is given anywhere in the filing for the 40.4% (+Rs.42.8mn) YoY jump in Group Selling and distribution costs, the single largest identifiable driver of the swing to a net loss -- cannot attribute it to a specific cause (freight rates, new distribution channel, one-off logistics cost, etc.); (2) no segmental note is presented anywhere in this filing (PACK is a single-line corrugated-carton packaging manufacturer, so this is expected rather than a true gap, but it does mean product-mix or customer-mix drivers of the revenue growth cannot be identified); (3) the Company-level 95.4% (Rs.21.4mn) collapse in 'Other income and gains' is not itemised; (4) the filing does not explain why no income tax was charged in the current quarter versus a Rs.16.4mn (Group) / Rs.14.2mn (Company) expense a year earlier -- plausibly reflecting the pre-tax loss itself (Group) or brought-forward tax attributes, but not confirmed by any note in this filing. Not a gap: the cash flow statement is confirmed genuinely quarterly (3-month, 'For the Quarter ended 30th June' with only 2026/2025 columns), so no YTD-vs-quarterly ambiguity exists here (unlike EML this batch).
interim_updates.takeaway: The swing to a small Group net loss (Rs.8.1mn vs a Rs.34.9mn profit) is a cost-and-financing story, not a revenue problem: Group revenue grew a healthy 13.5%, but Selling & distribution costs (+40.4%, +Rs.42.8mn) and finance costs (+22.2%, +Rs.20.2mn) together added Rs.63.0mn of cost against only Rs.26.6mn of incremental gross profit. Selling & distribution cost growth alone exceeded the entire gross-profit gain, and is the single largest identifiable driver of the operating-profit decline -- worth understanding whether this reflects a one-off distribution/logistics cost spike or a structural increase as PACK scales. Operating cash flow remained negative and worsened YoY (Rs.647.0mn outflow vs Rs.524.1mn) on inventory build and a large payables paydown, funded by Rs.501.8mn of fresh borrowing -- balance-sheet leverage (short-term interest-bearing borrowings of Rs.4,351.5mn, up from Rs.3,753.9mn at 31 March 2026) is the thing to watch into Q2 if the cost pressures identified here persist.

operational_highlights: Group revenue +13.5% YoY to Rs.2,531.3mn (2025: Rs.2,230.7mn); Group swung from a Rs.34.9mn profit to a Rs.8.1mn loss for the period (incl. NCI), a Rs.43.0mn decline.
Gross margin fell to 17.3% from 18.4% as cost of sales grew 15.1% (Rs.2,093.6mn vs Rs.1,819.6mn), outpacing 13.5% revenue growth; gross profit rose only 6.5% (+Rs.26.6mn).

Selling & distribution costs +40.4% YoY (Rs.148.7mn vs Rs.105.9mn, +Rs.42.8mn) -- on its own larger than the entire Rs.26.6mn gross profit gain; administrative expenses +10.2% (Rs.208.8mn vs Rs.189.5mn).
Operating profit -27.7% YoY to Rs.102.7mn (2025: Rs.142.0mn); finance cost +22.2% to Rs.110.8mn (2025: Rs.90.6mn), pushing Group PBT from a Rs.51.3mn profit to a Rs.8.1mn loss.
No income tax charged this quarter (2025: Rs.16.4mn expense) -- partially cushioned the swing to a net loss.

Company (standalone) PAT Rs.2.2mn (2025: Rs.31.5mn, -92.9%), pressured by the same Selling & distribution cost (+43.5%) and finance cost (+17.8%) increases, plus a 95.4% (Rs.21.4mn) collapse in Other income and gains.

Net cash used in operating activities widened to Rs.647.0mn (2025: Rs.524.1mn) on a Rs.313.2mn inventory build and a Rs.526.6mn paydown of trade and other payables; funded by Rs.501.8mn of net new interest-bearing borrowing.
key_drivers: Selling & distribution costs +40.4% YoY (Rs.148.7mn vs Rs.105.9mn, a Rs.42.8mn increase) is the single largest identifiable driver of the operating-profit decline, exceeding the entire Rs.26.6mn gross-profit gain -- not broken down further by the filing.
Finance cost +22.2% YoY (Rs.110.8mn vs Rs.90.6mn, +Rs.20.2mn) is what tipped the Group from a Rs.51.3mn pre-tax profit into a Rs.8.1mn pre-tax loss, on top of the operating-profit decline.
Cost of sales growth (+15.1%) outpaced revenue growth (+13.5%), compressing gross margin from 18.4% to 17.3% and limiting gross profit growth to +6.5% despite double-digit revenue growth.

Zero income tax charge this quarter (2025: Rs.16.4mn expense) added back Rs.16.4mn to the bottom line relative to the prior year's tax burden, partially offsetting the operating and financing cost pressures.
